mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approvals (work_item_id, status_id, requested_by, approver_id, approver_role, decision) VALUES (#{workItemId}, #{statusId}, #{requestedBy}, #{approverId}, #{approverRole}, COALESCE(#{decision}, 'PENDING'))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE work_item_id = #{workItemId} ORDER BY id DESC
